source: ECharts 6.1.0 dist (echarts.js), node SSR, SVG renderer
notes: Every option has animation false; the force layouts layoutAnimation false; Math.random is the xorshift32 from SEED, reseeded per chart and before every set.
A thumbnail's copy is taken at the graph's render: symbol shapes are the sub-path's scaleX / scaleY (half the symbol size) round the node, lines the line path's shape.
pars[].window etc. are _makeLayoutInfo run on a copy of the option's window (recording must not rewrite it); optWindow is the option's own array.
actions are what views dispatched through api.dispatchAction, tagged by the view; an action step's own dispatch is chart.dispatchAction and is not listed.

scenarios.note: a 'none' graph with six symbols, a rim, a curve, a dash, an arrow: the copy, its view and window; the graph's own roam (action pan and zoom, a wheel, a drag) moves the window; a drag and wheels on the thumbnail roam the graph; a wheel and a drag on the rim outside the content; hovering the box hides what is under it
the styles: a merge of windowStyle (colour, radius, rim, opacity) and itemStyle (fill, radius, rim); the backgroundColor fill; a resize; notMerge
box positions through notMerge (the init mergeLayoutParam): left / top, centred, percentages, sides only, a wide rim and a radius list; a zoomed and centred graph
a force layout (layoutAnimation false) with categories, roam 'move': a drag on the thumbnail pans, its wheel does not zoom; a zoom by the action
a circular layout, roam 'scale': the thumbnail zooms and does not pan; the graph's wheel; a merge that re-renders the copy

which graph: seriesIndex, seriesId, none (the first graph), no graph at all, a graph on cartesian2d (an empty box), a graph with no links (the empty line group puts (0, 0) in the copy), two thumbnails (the last one gets the copy), show false, roam false

the static layouts a merge leaves: centres 0, 7 and 2.5, counts 2 and 7, widths 30 and 200 (the window restricted to the layout), an explicit window, a count of 0 (not expandable), three axes, the layout off

the click trigger, horizontal: a click in the window's middle (none), at its left and right edges (slide), far left and far right (jump), a press and a release 3 px apart (dist 9 > 5: nothing) and 2 / 1 px apart (5: a click), outside the parallel (none), repeated jumps to the ends of the extent; brushselected follows every event
the click trigger, vertical, a custom slide trigger area [-0.3, 0.2, 0.5] and an axisExpandWindow in the option; and a trigger area with no jump ([null, 0.1, 0.5])

the mousemove trigger: a slide every 5 ms through the throttle (17 ms: a timer, then the last call's window), a jump debounced 50 ms and cancelled by a move into the middle ('none' clears the timer), a jump that lands, a slide with animation duration 0, moves off the parallel; a merged axisExpandRate 40 and axisExpandDebounce 0
a collapse width under 3 px (folded to 0): the narrow branch maps the pointer over the whole extent; click and move triggers

the action: a window with fractions (the option's array rewritten by every layout, the event's with it), a centre (the window from before still wins), a null window (back to the centre), a count, a width, expandable off and on, by parallelIndex / parallelId on two parallels and with no query (both); the event's keys

brushing with collapsed axes, click trigger: a cover on a window axis, a jump that folds it (the cover follows the axis), a cover on a folded axis, the action on a folded axis, a slide; the rows keep their opacities

[R2-I4] the nodes' pens the copy clones from the Symbol paths: a node with only a borderColor (zrender's 1 px), one dashed at 2 with its own phase, one in a category by name (its border [3, 1] at 2 and its opacity), an emptyCircle (its colour at 2), a rect of no border; a dashed edge with its phase

guards.mutation: the content rect shrunk by the whole rim
the view rect takes 0.75 of the content's side
the window ignores the graph transform
the layout does not rewrite the window
the slide zone at 10% instead of the trigger area
